# dynamics_api { #tvbo.api.dynamics_api }

`api.dynamics_api`

Dynamics model API — serves neural mass models from the tvbo database.

## Endpoints {.doc-section .doc-section-endpoints}

GET /api/v1/dynamics              — list available models (filterable) GET /api/v1/dynamics/{id}/sidecar — LinkML-valid YAML or JSON

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [MODEL_DIR](#tvbo.api.dynamics_api.MODEL_DIR) |  |
| [router](#tvbo.api.dynamics_api.router) |  |

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_sidecar](#tvbo.api.dynamics_api.get_sidecar) | Download full LinkML-valid model definition (YAML or JSON). |
| [list_dynamics](#tvbo.api.dynamics_api.list_dynamics) | List available dynamics models. |

### get_sidecar { #tvbo.api.dynamics_api.get_sidecar }

```python
api.dynamics_api.get_sidecar(model_id, format=Query('yaml'))
```

Download full LinkML-valid model definition (YAML or JSON).

### list_dynamics { #tvbo.api.dynamics_api.list_dynamics }

```python
api.dynamics_api.list_dynamics(system_type=Query(None), name=Query(None))
```

List available dynamics models.
